7.4.3.3.3.3 Com Low Proxy
[SWS_SwCluC_03549] Provision of ComUserCbkHandleId values Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211
⌈The Com Low Proxy shall provide in its ComUserModuleCnf containers the ComUserCbkHandleId values for the configured ComUserIPdus, according to its internal implementation requirements (e.g. to address the Com Low Proxy’s data structures).⌋
[SWS_SwCluC_03519] The Com Low Proxy shall provide the entry function for transmission requests Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211
⌈The Com Low Proxy shall provide the entry function for transmission requests, according to [SWS_SwCluC_03506], once per configured SwCluCComProxyBaseSocket at the EcucPartition configured by SwCluCComProxyBaseSocket. SwCluCProxyEcucPartitionRef.
⌋
[SWS_SwCluC_03521] Provide an instance of all SwCluC_ComProxy_ComCbkRxIndication notification callbacks Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211
⌈The Com Low Proxy shall provide an instance of all SwCluC_ComProxy_ComCbkRxIndication notification callbacks, configured via the ComUserCallbackName (See [ECUC_Com_10036]) parameter, with ComUserCallbackType (See
[ECUC_Com_10034]) set to COM_RX_INDICATION.⌋ module
[SWS_SwCluC_CONSTR_03555] Existence of SwCluC_ComProxy_ComCbkRxIndication Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211
⌈Each SwCluC_ComProxy_ComCbkRxIndication notification callback, where the parameter ComUserCallbackType (See [ECUC_Com_10034]) is set to COM_RX_INDICATION, shall be configured as SwCluC_ComProxy_<BS>_ComCbkRxIndication, where <BS> is the shortName of the SwCluCComProxyBaseSocket container.⌋
